## What's changed

- Speeds up **Breaks & Credits** analysis with hardware-assisted video decoding when the configured transcoder supports it.
- Automatically retries an unsupported hardware-decoding job in software, so acceleration problems do not prevent marker sidecars from being created.
- Analyzes up to two local videos concurrently while the server is idle, with concurrency-safe progress and status reporting.
- Adds an independent **Pause for playback** setting to Breaks & Credits and keeps the existing Library Optimization playback-pause control easy to understand.
- Finishes files already in progress before pausing new work, clearly reports when a queue is waiting for playback, and resumes automatically afterward.
- Preserves safe restart behavior: completed sidecars and optimizer records are reused, while an interrupted file is processed again from the beginning without replacing the original with partial output.

These are server-managed updates. Existing Tater Tube players do not require an update.
